text: {"assertions":["A request timeout issue was discovered in services/auth/session_store.py on 2026-01-29.","The request timeout only occurred for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider.","The issue could be reproduced by sending POST /login twice against a warm cache.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The timeout was signaled by a 30 second deadline appearing in gateway logs.","The alert for this issue remained silent for 52 consecutive days before being detected.","The fix involved removing the listener on teardown and adding a test assertion to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted in PR #5242 on branch fix/request-timeout-1."]}
